newsitem.title: GERMANY: Pittler says bankruptcy proceedings begin.
newsitem.headline: Pittler says bankruptcy proceedings begin.

text.p: German machine tools company Pittler AG said on Wednesday that a court has opened bankruptcy proceedings. It was the second group in two days to announce such a step.
The group also said an administrator has been appointed.
Pittler sought bankruptcy protection in late January after it was unable to pay bills and possibly lost more than half of its base capital.
On Tuesday Traub AG also declared bankruptcy but said investors were interested in possibly acquiring the group.
